description: This file defines a sealed class 'Result' used to represent the outcome of operations, including Success, Error, and Loading states. It also provides extension functions to check if a result is successful and to retrieve data if available.

classes.name: Result
classes.description: A sealed class representing operation results with success, error, and loading states.

methods.name: isSuccess
methods.description: Extension function to check if the Result is a Success.

methods.name: getOrNull
methods.description: Extension function to retrieve data from a Success Result or null if not successful.
